title: The Lighthouse That Sold Fog
mood: salty seaside, cool blue-grey sea light by day, deep navy night with a warm golden lighthouse beam, playful and mischievous

voice.delivery: calm deadpan storyteller, dry wit, unhurried pace

music: quirky understated sea-shanty instrumental, plucked mandolin, soft accordion, light upright bass, mischievous mood, occasional distant foghorn, loopable

characters.gus: old lighthouse keeper; yellow fisherman's sou'wester rain hat, big bushy white beard covering the lower face, small dot eyes, bushy white eyebrows; chunky navy cable-knit sweater as the bean-shaped torso; often holds a brass oil lantern
characters.inspector: shipping company inspector; small black bowler hat, perfectly round wire glasses, thin neat moustache; grey three-piece suit torso with a red tie; always carries a clipboard
characters.rival: the new lighthouse keeper; red knit beanie, slicked black hair, narrow sly eyes, a crooked grin; striped red-and-white sailor shirt torso
characters.captain: ship captain; white captain's cap with a gold anchor, grey stubble; navy pea-coat torso with brass buttons

locations.island: Gull Rock: a small rocky island in a grey-green bay with a tall red-and-white striped lighthouse, a tiny keeper's cottage, seagulls, crashing waves, a little wooden dock with a rowboat
locations.lamp_room: the cozy lamp room at the top of the lighthouse: a giant brass Fresnel lens, brass fittings, round windows looking over the sea, a kettle and a mug on a small table
locations.theatre: the dusty backstage of an old closing-down theatre: velvet curtains, stacked props, spotlights, cobwebs, a sale table full of odd stage equipment
locations.bay_night: the bay at night: dark navy water, moonlight, distant ship lights, the lighthouse beam sweeping across
locations.ship_bridge: the wheelhouse of a small cargo ship at night: wooden ship's wheel, brass compass, rain-streaked windows
locations.dock_night: the little wooden dock below the lighthouse at night: lanterns, coiled ropes, crates, mist curling over the water

shots.visual: bright clear sunny day; the striped lighthouse on its rocky island in a calm sparkling bay, not a cloud or wisp of fog anywhere
shots.motion: camera flies low over the waves toward the island; seagulls circle; waves break on the rocks
shots.narration: This man gets paid fifty dollars for every ship that doesn't crash.

shots.visual: Gus proudly polishing the giant brass lighthouse lens with a rag
shots.motion: Gus rubs the lens in big circles; sunlight glints and flares off the glass
shots.narration: This is Gus. He keeps the lighthouse on Gull Rock.

shots.visual: a memory: a ship lost in thick fog turns safely toward the golden lighthouse beam
shots.motion: the beam sweeps through the fog; the ship slowly turns toward it; mist drifts
shots.narration: When fog rolls in and his light guides a ship home, the company pays him.

shots.visual: Gus sits on the rocks under a perfectly clear blue sky, ships sailing past easily in the distance
shots.motion: ships glide by; a seagull lands next to Gus; he doesn't move
shots.narration: There's just one problem. The fog hasn't come in for ten years.

shots.visual: Gus holding open an empty brown wallet, a single moth inside, deadpan face
shots.motion: the moth flutters out of the wallet; Gus blinks slowly
shots.narration: No fog. No rescues. No money.

shots.visual: Gus at a dusty theatre sale table, eyebrows shooting up as he spots something
shots.motion: dust motes float in a spotlight beam; Gus's bushy eyebrows rise; he leans in
shots.narration: Then, at a closing-down theatre sale, Gus finds something.

shots.visual: a battered old black stage fog machine with a dial and a nozzle, lit dramatically by a spotlight
shots.motion: the spotlight flickers on; a small puff of leftover smoke coughs from the nozzle

shots.visual: first-person POV rowing a small rowboat at night, Gus's cartoon hands on the oars, the fog machine sitting in the bow, the lighthouse behind
shots.motion: oars dip and pull, the boat rocks gently, moonlight on the ripples
shots.narration: That night, he rows it out into the middle of the bay...

shots.visual: Gus's finger on the fog machine's big switch, his eyes narrowed with a sly look
shots.motion: click - the switch flips; the machine rumbles and a thick white cloud of fog blasts out

shots.visual: the whole bay swallowed in thick white fog, only the golden lighthouse beam cutting through it
shots.motion: fog rolls and billows across the water; the beam sweeps; distant ship lights blink in confusion
shots.narration: By midnight, nobody can see a thing.

shots.visual: the captain gripping the ship's wheel in panic, wide eyes, then the golden beam shines through the window onto his face
shots.motion: the captain sweats and spins the wheel; the beam sweeps across; his face melts into relief
shots.narration: Captains panic. Then they see the light.

shots.visual: Gus at the lamp room table counting a growing stack of cash by lantern light, big grin under the beard
shots.motion: Gus licks his thumb and flicks bills onto the pile one by one; the beam sweeps behind him
shots.narration: Fifty dollars. Fifty dollars. Fifty dollars.

shots.visual: Gus loading five fog machines into a now overloaded rowboat that sits low in the water
shots.motion: Gus heaves one more machine in; the rowboat dips lower; ropes creak
shots.narration: So Gus buys two more machines. Then five.

shots.visual: seen from high above: the entire bay buried under a thick ocean of fog, only the tip of the lighthouse poking out
shots.motion: camera pulls back and up; fog churns like a sea of cotton; the beam sweeps across the top
shots.narration: Soon, it's the foggiest harbor in the country.

shots.visual: the inspector steps off a boat onto the foggy dock with his clipboard; Gus beside him with a single sweat drop
shots.motion: the inspector adjusts his glasses; fog swirls around their legs; Gus's sweat drop slides
shots.narration: So the company sends an inspector.

shots.visual: the inspector peering into the thick fog, then beaming with delight and scribbling on his clipboard
shots.motion: his eyebrows rise above his round glasses; he scribbles fast; his moustache curls up
shots.narration: He takes one look at all that fog... and orders a second lighthouse.

shots.visual: a brand-new shiny blue-and-white lighthouse right next to Gus's old one, the rival keeper waving from its balcony
shots.motion: the new lighthouse's lamp blinks on for the first time; the rival waves with a crooked grin
shots.narration: So they build one. Right next door.

shots.visual: from high in Gus's lighthouse window: the rival keeper tiptoeing down to the dock at night, hugging a fog machine
shots.motion: the rival tiptoes in exaggerated sneaky steps, looking left and right
shots.narration: That night, Gus sees the new keeper sneaking down to the docks...

shots.visual: close-up of Gus at the round window, completely deadpan, one eye twitching
shots.motion: slow push-in; Gus's left eye twitches twice; the beam sweeps behind him
